title: Sunset Katana 2
author: Telios29
selftext:
Hey guys.  I finally finished the sequel to a game I made last year (the first version was made with G Develop and no AI.)  This one was mostly made with Sol 6.1 on high/extra high reasoning in Codex.  It's the way I wanted the first one to be all along.  Looking for feedback.  Let me know what you all think. Thx!  If it does okay on one of these html5 sites, maybe I'd consider porting it to Steam or something.  It's totally F2P right now. 

Made with AI. Brought to you by #PlaygamaMCP. Fine-tuned by me. Sunset Katana 2 → [https://playgama.ai/play/dbj2lvjqybixcw](https://playgama.ai/play/dbj2lvjqybixcw)
